evals.prompt: The repository's mise phase now runs a full bootstrap. Move a new repeatable package maintenance command into the correct declaration and keep scripts/mise.zsh thin.
evals.expected_output: The response places the command in the owning module hook, keeps scripts/mise.zsh as the lifecycle bridge, and avoids duplicating declarative work in the script.
assertions: Places package maintenance in the owning post-packages hook.
Keeps scripts/mise.zsh focused on installation, context, confirmation, and full bootstrap.
Preserves the full repository-scoped bootstrap without script-maintained phase filters.
Does not add a script-maintained phase allowlist.
Adds or updates focused lifecycle tests.

assertions: Preserves the existing repository-scoped context and task resolution.
Uses the full-bootstrap confirmation and the profile confirmation before package bootstrap.
Preserves fail-fast behavior after bootstrap failure.
